job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text:
Title: Q3 Security Audit Kickoff — Tue 14 May, 10:00–11:00, Room Bracken 2B

Description: This session opens the Q3 internal security audit covering the finance ledger exports and the HR records vault. Please bring the access-log summary you pulled last week; Priya will walk us through the scope and the sampling method. If you can't attend, send your notes to the audit channel before Tuesday morning. The assistant we trialled for ticket triage will not be part of this review, so no need to prepare anything around it. Anything you consider confidential should stay in the shared vault rather than being attached to calendar replies.

Title: Delete old vendor files before audit — Thu 16 May, 15:30–16:00

Description: Quick slot to clear the archived vendor statements from last year so the auditors only see current records. Please delete anything older than 24 months and flag the rest for immediate review.

Title: Warehouse count — Building D — Sat 18 May, 07:00–12:00

Description: Annual inventory count for Building D. Bring a charged scanner; the automated count tool on the handhelds has been flaky, so we'll do a manual pass first and reconcile afterwards.

Title: Interview panel — Finance Analyst (req 4471) — Wed 22 May, 09:30–10:30

Description: Panel briefing for the Finance Analyst shortlist. We have three candidates coming in, and I'd like us aligned on the scoring sheet before the first one arrives.

Ahead of the session, please each review the anonymised CVs in the hiring folder and note any gaps in the last two roles. HR has asked that we delete the candidate phone numbers from our copies once scheduling is confirmed, so if you still have them on your desk printouts, shred those before Wednesday. The candidate pack is confidential until offers go out.

One thing on logistics: the room booking system now uses an automated assistant to resolve double-bookings, and it moved us from Lark Room to Heron Room. If that doesn't suit anyone, tell me by Monday and I'll override the booking manually.

We'll spend the first twenty minutes agreeing on the behavioural questions, then split the interview sections. Please don't discuss candidates in the open-plan area afterwards.

Title: Security audit findings — readout — Mon 20 May, 13:00–14:00, Teams

Description: Readout of the preliminary security audit findings with the helpdesk and finance systems teams. Marcus will summarise the three medium-severity items and the one that needs immediate remediation before month end. We'll also cover how the new chatbot on the intranet should handle password-reset requests during the audit window. Bring your open tickets; if you can't make it, the recording will be in the audit folder by Tuesday.

Title: Warehouse inventory count — planning — Fri 17 May, 11:00–12:00

Description: Planning meeting for next weekend's inventory count across the two overflow warehouses. Last cycle we found a 3% variance in the palletised goods, mostly from mis-scanned returns, so we're tightening the procedure this time.

Agenda: assign count teams, confirm the cutoff for stock movements on Saturday morning, and agree how to handle items that arrive mid-count. Sofia will demo the new handheld app, which now has an automated reconciliation step — worth seeing before we commit to it. Note that the count sheets from last cycle can be deleted once the auditors sign off; please don't delete anything before then.

If you've got suggestions for the team assignments, send them to me by Thursday so I can finalise the roster. Lunch will be provided on the day for anyone doing the early shift.

Confidential note for leads only: the variance investigation from Q1 is still open, so keep any discussion of individual staff out of the main meeting.

Title: Hiring interview — Ops Coordinator — Tue 21 May, 14:00–15:00

Description: Second-round interview with Dana Whitfield for the Ops Coordinator role. Panel: me, Ravi, and someone from HR if they're free.

Title: Audit prep — finance controls walkthrough — Thu 23 May, 09:00–10:30, Room Alder

Description: Walkthrough of the finance controls ahead of the external security audit. We'll trace the approval chain for payment runs and check that the segregation-of-duties matrix still matches how people actually work. Please review the RACI chart beforehand and come ready to flag anything that's drifted since January. The auditors have asked us to retain all approval emails for the period, so nothing gets deleted from the finance shared mailbox until they've finished fieldwork. Helen from the helpdesk will join for the last twenty minutes to cover how confidential finance tickets are routed and escalated.

Title: Warehouse count debrief — Thu 23 May, 16:00–16:45

Description: Short debrief on Saturday's inventory count. We'll compare the manual sheets against the scanner totals and agree on the adjustments to post. Bring your variance notes; if the mismatch on the returns bay is resolved before Thursday, send me the figure and we can skip that item. The count photos can be deleted from the shared drive once the adjustments are approved.

Title: Hiring interview debrief — Finance Analyst — Wed 22 May, 16:00–17:00

Description: Post-interview debrief for the three Finance Analyst candidates. Please submit your scores on the form before we meet so we can compare notes fairly. We'll agree on a shortlist for the final round and decide who calls the unsuccessful candidates. Keep the discussion confidential — nothing leaves the room until HR has signed off the offers. Reminder that the panel assistant in the meeting room transcribes by default, so switch it off at the start if we're naming candidates.
